pages.text: Right-click to throw one iron dagger down your view. It strikes what is in the way for 6 damage and then comes back to you — the dagger leaves your stack for the throw, not out of your life.

Each throw spends one dagger, and it is back in your hand after landing. The $(bold)Dagger Glove$() is the same blade with more ways to throw it.$(br2)A thrown dagger returns to your inventory, or drops at your feet when you have no room for it, as soon as it hits a block, hits a creature, or has flown its full two seconds.
